title: Control Testing & Assurance Program
rationale: SOC 2, ISO 27001, and SOX all require formal control testing documentation. Without this, the platform is a documentation system, not an assurance system. Extends existing Controls and Evidence modules.

user_stories.story: As a Compliance Manager, I want to define a testing schedule for each control (Quarterly/Annual), so that we maintain continuous assurance.
acceptance_criteria: Manager can set testing frequency per control (Monthly, Quarterly, Semi-Annual, Annual).
System generates upcoming test tasks based on schedule.
Dashboard shows controls due for testing.

user_stories.story: As a Compliance Manager, I want to define formal test procedures for each control, so that testing is consistent and repeatable.
acceptance_criteria: Manager can write step-by-step test procedures linked to a control.
Tester sees the procedure when executing a test.

user_stories.story: As an Internal Auditor, I want to execute a test by selecting a sample and recording Pass/Fail results, so that I have documented evidence of testing.
acceptance_criteria: Tester can select a sample size.
System suggests random samples from the evidence population where possible.
Tester records Pass/Fail per sample item.
Tester can add notes and attach evidence for each test item.

user_stories.story: As an Internal Auditor, I want a sign-off workflow for completed tests, so that results are formally approved.
acceptance_criteria: Tester submits completed test for review.
Reviewer can approve, reject, or request re-test.
Approved tests are immutably logged with timestamp and reviewer identity.

user_stories.story: As a Compliance Manager, I want to view historical test results and trend analysis, so that I can identify weakening controls.
acceptance_criteria: Dashboard shows pass/fail rate per control over time.
Controls with declining pass rates are flagged.
Exportable test history for external auditors.
